preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 3 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= K <= N <= 10**5 and 0 <= M <= 10**5 and 1 <= S <= N and 1 <= X <= 10**9 for _ in range(T))
preconditions.description: For each test case, N, K, M, S, and X satisfy the stated constraints.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N and 1 <= c <= 10**9 for a, b, c in all_new_roads)
preconditions.description: All new roads connect valid cities within [1, N] and have positive lengths.

preconditions.expression: all(a != b for a, b, _ in all_new_roads)
preconditions.description: No road connects a city to itself.

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(a,b), max(a,b)) for a, b, _ in all_new_roads)) == len(all_new_roads)
preconditions.description: All new roads are distinct pairs.

preconditions.expression: all((min(a,b), max(a,b)) not in old_city_pairs for a, b, _ in all_new_roads)
preconditions.description: No new road duplicates an existing road between two old cities (1 to K).
The graph formed by all old and new roads is connected.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N and all(x.isdigit() for x in line.split()) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N space-separated non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all(distances[i-1] == shortest_path_distance(S, i, N, K, X, new_roads) for i, distances in enumerate(zip(range(1, N+1), [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the i-th integer in the output line equals the minimum total length of a path from city S to city i in the graph defined by the old and new roads.

postconditions.expression: all(distances[S-1] == 0 for distances in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines])
postconditions.description: The distance from S to itself is 0 for every test case.
